meta.name: keyless-wiring-test
meta.description: For suites that assert server wiring and never run a codon. The model is real (startup asks Pi to confirm it against its catalog) and Pi now checks credentials for every provider, so each codon's env block carries a placeholder DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: the check passes with no API keys in the process environment, which is what lets these suites live in the keyless offline tier. Never autostart a run against this config: the placeholder key would fail at the provider.

hank.name: Codon 1: Never Invoked
hank.promptText: This codon must never run. If you are reading this, a wiring-only test autostarted its config.

hank.name: Codon 2: Never Invoked
hank.promptText: This codon must never run either.
